title: AI errors & omissions for SMEs
text: We cover legal liability your business incurs because an AI system you operate or recommend has provided incorrect output to a customer, leading to demonstrable financial loss. Cover applies to small and medium enterprises declared in the Schedule with annual turnover up to EUR 50,000,000.

title: Cyber & data breach extension
text: Following a confirmed cyber incident affecting an AI system you operate, we cover incident response, customer notification costs and lost business income for up to 90 days, subject to the per-claim limit shown in the Schedule.

title: Defence costs
text: We pay defence costs for civil claims and regulatory investigations relating to the use of AI by your business, including reasonable counsel fees pre-approved by us.

title: Exclusion — autonomous high-risk systems
text: We do not cover claims arising from AI systems classified as high-risk under Annex III of the EU AI Act unless specifically endorsed. SME plans default to limited-risk and minimal-risk use-cases.

title: Exclusion — generative content liability
text: We do not cover liability arising from defamatory, infringing or unlawful content generated by an AI system where you have failed to implement reasonable output review or content filters.

title: Exclusion — fines and penalties
text: Fines, penalties and punitive damages imposed by any regulator are excluded, save where insurable by law and specifically endorsed in the policy schedule.

title: Condition — record keeping
text: You shall maintain records of AI system inputs, outputs and version changes for a minimum of 24 months, available on reasonable request from us in connection with a claim.

title: Deductible — each and every claim
text: Each claim is subject to a deductible of EUR 5,000 for SME plans, or EUR 10,000 where the AI system processes special-category personal data.

title: Aggregate limit
text: Annual aggregate limit of EUR 2,000,000 across all coverage sections; cyber response sub-limit EUR 500,000.
